relations.subject: Albert von Le Coq
relations.evidence: sold his firm in 1900. Studied Arabic, Turkish and Persian at Orientalisches Seminar in Berlin.

relations.subject: Albert von Le Coq
relations.evidence: The silent man was soon noted by F. W. K. Müller and A. Grünwedel, who employed him in arranging a collection of Oriental clothes

relations.evidence: In 1914 he became the acting Director of the Asian Department in Museum für Völkerkunde (formally only 1923)

relations.subject: Albert von Le Coq
relations.evidence: As an archaeologist he was ruthless, separating entire wall-paintings, and quarrelled with Grünwedel, who was more interested in preservation.
